title: Dell shares rocket on bullish forecast for AI demand
title_zh: 戴尔股价因人工智能需求乐观预测而飙升
summary: STORY: :: DellDell shares rocketed higher in after-hours trade Thursday, jumping around 39%.The surge came after the computer maker lifted revenue and profit expectations.Dell says it is seeing soaring demand for AI-optimized servers used in data centers.It’s benefiting as tec...
summary_zh: 故事：：戴尔戴尔股价周四在盘后交易中飙升，涨幅约为 39%。在这家计算机制造商上调收入和利润预期后，股价飙升。戴尔表示，它看到数据中心使用的人工智能优化服务器的需求不断飙升。随着技术的发展，它受益匪浅。

title: Samsung Electronics ships faster HBM4E chip samples to customers; shares jump
title_zh: 三星电子向客户交付更快的 HBM4E 芯片样品；股价上涨
summary: Samsung Electronics on Friday said it started shipping samples of its latest high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chip to customers, pulling ahead of rivals in distributing a new version of the product critical to ‌AI data centers and sending its shares higher.
summary_zh: 三星电子周五表示，它开始向客户运送最新的高带宽内存 (HBM) 芯片样品，在分发对 AI 数据中心至关重要的新版本产品方面领先于竞争对手，并推高了其股价。

title: Samsung Electronics ships HBM4E chip samples to global customers
title_zh: 三星电子向全球客户运送 HBM4E 芯片样品
summary: Samsung Electronics said on Friday it has started shipping ‌samples of its latest high-bandwidth memory (HBM) ‌chip, or the 12-layer HBM4E, marking what it said ​was the industry's first shipment of such products.
summary_zh: 三星电子周五表示，已开始发货其最新高带宽内存 (HBM) 芯片（即 12 层 HBM4E）的样品，这标志着业界首次发货此类产品。

title: Australian watchdog sues Amazon unit over children's backpack safety
title_zh: 澳大利亚监管机构就儿童背包安全问题起诉亚马逊部门
summary: Australia's competition watchdog said on Friday that it has initiated legal action against Amazon's local unit, alleging breaches ‌of product safety labelling laws related to children's backpacks.
summary_zh: 澳大利亚竞争监管机构周五表示，已对亚马逊当地部门提起法律诉讼，指控其违反与儿童背包相关的产品安全标签法。

title: Apollo, Blackstone work on $36 billion debt deal for Anthropic, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，Apollo 和 Blackstone 正在为 Anthropic 进行 360 亿美元的债务交易
summary: Apollo Global Management and Blackstone are working to bring in additional investors ‌for about $36 billion debt financing tied to AI ‌startup Anthropic PBC's efforts to expand its AI infrastructure, Bloomberg ​News reported on Thursday.
summary_zh: 据彭博社周四报道，Apollo Global Management 和 Blackstone 正在努力引入更多投资者，为人工智能初创公司 Anthropic PBC 扩大其人工智能基础设施的努力提供约 360 亿美元的债务融资。

title: Apollo Shops $36 Billion Debt Deal to Buy Google Chips for Anthropic
title_zh: Apollo 斥资 360 亿美元债务交易为 Anthropic 购买谷歌芯片
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Apollo Global Management Inc. and Blackstone Inc. are working to bring additional investors into a roughly $36 billion debt financing deal to help Anthropic PBC build out its AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: (彭博社) -- Apollo Global Management Inc. 和 Blackstone Inc. 正在努力吸引更多投资者参与一项约 360 亿美元的债务融资交易，以帮助 Anthropic PBC 建设其人工智能基础设施。
